    Publish to GitHub

    Sends your latest content and the link-preview pages straight to your repo, so there is nothing to download, unzip or upload by hand.

    One-time setup: open GitHub’s token page, give the token a name, under Repository access choose “Only select repositories” and pick this repo, then under Permissions set Contents to “Read and write”. Generate it and paste it above. The token stays in this browser only and is never put in your data.

    Link previews

    A link only shows a preview card in Discord when that ability has its own preview page on your site. This tool makes those pages and checks that they are online.

    Site password

    Visitors will have to enter this before they can see anything. Your content in data.json gets encrypted with it, so keep the password somewhere safe: if it is lost, the published data cannot be opened. Export data.json and upload it for the change to go live.

    Copy moveset

    Copy moves and passives from an ability sheet into this one.
